name: realestate-tools
description: A comprehensive suite of 31 professional calculators for real estate investors.

tools.name: calculate_affordability
tools.description: Calculates home affordability based on annual income, monthly debts, and savings.

monthly_debts.description: Total minimum monthly debt payments (car, credit cards, student loans).

savings.description: Total cash available for down payment and closing costs.

annual_insurance_rate.description: Annual insurance cost as a percentage of home price.

annual_tax_rate.description: Annual property tax as a percentage of home price.

closing_costs_pct.description: Closing costs as a percentage of home price.

tools.name: analyze_brrrr_deal
tools.description: Analyzes a BRRRR (Buy, Rehab, Rent, Refinance, Repeat) deal.

arv.description: After Repair Value (estimated value after rehab).

refi_interest_rate.description: Interest rate for the refinance loan.

holding_costs.description: Total holding costs during rehab (taxes, insurance, utilities).

closing_costs_purchase.description: Closing costs for the initial purchase.

monthly_expense_pct.description: Monthly expenses as a percentage of rent (vacancy, maintenance, etc.).

tools.name: evaluate_house_hack
tools.description: Calculates savings and effective housing cost for a house hacking strategy.

purchase_price.description: Purchase price of the multi-unit property.

num_units.description: Total number of units in the property.

rent_owner_unit.description: Market rent for the unit you will live in (set to 0 if not renting it).

rent_other_units.description: Market rent for each of the other units.

vacancy_rate.description: Expected vacancy rate for rental units.

maintenance_rate.description: Maintenance cost as a percentage of total potential rent.

market_rent_comparison.description: The market rent for a similar single-family home or apartment you would otherwise rent.

tools.name: project_portfolio_growth
tools.description: Projects the growth of a real estate portfolio over a 20-year period.

annual_savings.description: Amount saved and invested each year.

acquisition_frequency_months.description: How often (in months) you plan to acquire a new property.

avg_property_price.description: Average purchase price of target properties.

avg_down_payment_pct.description: Average down payment percentage for each property.

avg_cocr.description: Average expected Cash-on-Cash Return for properties.

hold_period_years.description: Number of years to project growth.

tools.name: analyze_syndication
tools.description: Evaluates a real estate syndication investment opportunity.

preferred_return_pct.description: Preferred return rate paid to investors first.

sponsor_split_pct.description: Sponsor's share of profits after preferred return.

projected_irr.description: The projected Internal Rate of Return for the deal.

exit_value.description: Optional: Projected sale price at exit (overrides IRR projection).

tools.name: calculate_mortgage_affordability
tools.description: Advanced mortgage qualification calculator with dual income support. Uses the same logic as calculate_affordability.

savings.description: Total cash available for down payment and closing costs.

annual_insurance_rate.description: Annual insurance cost as a percentage of home price.

annual_tax_rate.description: Annual property tax as a percentage of home price.

closing_costs_pct.description: Closing costs as a percentage of home price.

tools.name: analyze_debt_to_income
tools.description: Analyzes Debt-to-Income ratio for different loan types.

gross_monthly_income.description: Total gross monthly income from all sources.

total_monthly_debts.description: Total of all monthly minimum debt payments.

proposed_monthly_piti.description: The proposed monthly mortgage payment (Principal, Interest, Taxes, Insurance).

tools.name: compare_loans
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of up to 4 loan scenarios.

loans.description: Array of loan scenarios to compare.

points.description: Points paid at closing (as a percentage of loan amount).

tools.name: calculate_irr
tools.description: Calculates Internal Rate of Return with sensitivity analysis.

initial_investment.description: The initial cash outflow (purchase price + costs).

cash_flows.description: Array of annual net cash flows (income - expenses). The last flow should include the sale proceeds.

tools.name: analyze_fix_flip
tools.description: Fix and flip profitability calculator.

selling_costs_pct.description: Selling costs as a percentage of ARV (e.g., agent commissions).

tools.name: calculate_npv
tools.description: Calculates Net Present Value with inflation adjustment.

discount_rate.description: The discount rate (your required rate of return).

cash_flows.description: Array of annual net cash flows.

tools.name: calculate_cocr
tools.description: Calculates Cash-on-Cash Return with 5-year projections.

monthly_expenses.description: Total monthly operating expenses (not including mortgage).

tools.name: calculate_dscr
tools.description: Calculates Debt Service Coverage Ratio for investment loans.

annual_operating_expenses.description: Total annual operating expenses (property management, maintenance, taxes, insurance, etc.).

tools.name: analyze_breakeven
tools.description: Performs breakeven analysis for rental properties.

total_monthly_expenses.description: Total monthly expenses including mortgage, taxes, insurance, maintenance, etc.

total_potential_rental_income.description: Total potential monthly rental income at 100% occupancy.

tools.name: analyze_sensitivity
tools.description: Performs multi-variable sensitivity analysis on a base investment value.

base_value.description: The base value to test sensitivity against (e.g., base IRR).

variables.description: Object where keys are variable names and values are arrays of change percentages to test (e.g., {'interest_rate': [-0.01, 0.01]}).

tools.name: run_monte_carlo
tools.description: Runs a Monte Carlo risk simulation (10,000+ scenarios).

stddev_return.description: The standard deviation of annual returns (volatility).

tools.name: calculate_tax_benefits
tools.description: Calculates tax benefits and depreciation for a rental property.

marginal_tax_rate.description: Your marginal federal income tax rate.

tools.name: compare_properties
tools.description: Compares up to 5 properties side-by-side using a weighted scoring model.

properties.description: Array of property objects to compare.

tools.name: analyze_refinance
tools.description: Analyzes a refinance opportunity with break-even and NPV calculations.

current_term_remaining_years.description: Years remaining on the current loan.

closing_costs.description: Total closing costs for the refinance.

tools.name: analyze_airbnb_str
tools.description: Analyzes Airbnb/Short-Term Rental income potential with seasonal variations.

tools.name: analyze_1031_exchange
tools.description: Analyzes a 1031 like-kind exchange for tax deferral.

sale_price.description: Sale price of the relinquished property.

depreciation_taken.description: Total depreciation taken on the property.

replacement_property_price.description: Purchase price of the replacement property.

tools.name: analyze_market_comps
tools.description: Performs a market analysis with comparable property analysis and CMA.

sqft.description: Square footage of the subject property.

tools.name: analyze_construction_loan
tools.description: Analyzes a construction loan with draw schedules and permanent financing.

total_project_cost.description: Total cost of the project (land + construction + soft costs).

loan_to_cost_ratio.description: Loan-to-Cost ratio offered by the lender.

interest_rate.description: Interest rate on the construction loan.

draw_schedule.description: Array of draw percentages per phase.

loan_term_months.description: Term of the construction loan in months.

tools.name: analyze_wholesale_deal
tools.description: Analyzes a wholesale deal with assignment fees and exit strategies.

contract_price.description: The price under the purchase contract.

estimated_repairs.description: Estimated repair costs for the end buyer.

assignment_fee.description: The fee you will charge to assign the contract.

tools.name: analyze_subject_to_deal
tools.description: Analyzes a 'subject-to' deal with existing mortgage takeover.

property_value.description: Current market value of the property.

existing_mortgage_balance.description: Current balance of the existing mortgage.

existing_mortgage_payment.description: Monthly payment of the existing mortgage.

tools.name: analyze_seller_financing
tools.description: Analyzes a seller financing deal with terms optimization.

sale_price.description: Full sale price of the property.

interest_rate.description: Interest rate on the seller note.

loan_term_years.description: Term of the seller financing in years.

tools.name: calculate_capital_gains_tax
tools.description: Calculates capital gains tax with optimization strategies.

holding_period_years.description: Number of years the property was held.

total_income.description: Your total annual income from other sources.

tools.name: analyze_rent_vs_buy
tools.description: Compares the costs and benefits of renting vs buying.

home_price.description: Price of the home you are considering buying.

investment_return.description: Expected annual return on invested savings.

tools.name: track_deal_pipeline
tools.description: Tracks and analyzes multiple deals through various stages.

deals.description: Array of deal objects in the pipeline.

tools.name: analyze_joint_venture
tools.description: Analyzes a joint venture partnership with profit splitting.

partner_investments.description: Array of investment amounts from each partner.

profit_split_pct.description: Total profit percentage to be split among partners (remainder may go to sponsor).

tools.name: analyze_property_management
tools.description: Compares self-management vs professional property management.

self_management_hours.description: Hours per month spent on management tasks.

professional_management_pct.description: Professional management fee as a percentage of rent.

tools.name: track_property_expenses
tools.description: Tracks and analyzes property expenses with benchmarking.
